historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved Donald Clark's final design for a plaza in Mission Dolores Park around a replica of the bell Father Miguel Hidalgo rang at Dolores, Mexico, in 1810, a gift of the Mexican government; it had accepted the gift in principle in April.

A lifeboat given by the United States Navy and converted into play apparatus was dedicated at Mission Dolores Playground on Thursday, November 6, as the general manager reported to the Recreation and Park Commission.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded Angotti & Reilly a $185,000 contract to build a soccer field at Mission Dolores Park.
First improved by the Park Commission, under the name Mission Park.
Mission Park was planted with trees and shrubs, for $5,667.29.
